final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor offered a narrower interpretation of the same admissible record, but no genuinely new admissible evidence was added. That matters here because the unresolved issue is not a minor explanatory caveat; it is the policy condition itself. The policy allows certification only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The record still shows a current refund-workflow regression, and still does not show current disclosure language, approved mitigation, or formal risk acceptance for that weakness. Aggregate readiness passing by 2.2 points and the absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support readiness, but they do not satisfy the missing documentation/control predicate. A caveated-compliance outcome would be appropriate only if the caveat described something ancillary while the compliance requirements were already met. Here, the proposed caveat is the unmet requirement, so the position remains noncompliant on the present record.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects the current evaluation results after the prompt-template change.
No admissible evidence shows the enterprise refund-workflow weakness is expressly disclosed in the current release packet.
No approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance tied to the current release is in evidence.
Prior approval from six weeks ago and the informal monitoring comment remain contextual only and do not satisfy the current-release policy predicate.
